fee_raw_24.sql: WITH wanted AS (SELECT * FROM unnest(%s::text[],%s::text[]) w(exchange,contract_id)) SELECT t.exchange,t.trade_date,t.contract_id,t.product_id,t.open_fee,t.offset_fee,t.short_open_fee,t.short_offset_fee,t.fee_style,t.fee_scale,t.source_url,t.source_sha256,t.fetched_at,t.raw FROM exchange_data.futures_settle_param t JOIN wanted w ON w.exchange=t.exchange AND w.contract_id=upper(t.contract_id) WHERE t.trade_date=%s::date ORDER BY t.exchange,t.contract_id

calendar_flags.sql: SELECT calendar_date,sfe,hkxe,created_at,updated_at,deleted_at FROM public.trading_calendar WHERE calendar_date BETWEEN %s::date AND %s::date ORDER BY calendar_date

catalog.sql: SELECT d.dataset_id,d.owner_project,d.state,d.source,d.adapter,d.runbook,r.relation FROM data_manager.dataset d JOIN data_manager.dataset_relation r USING(dataset_id) WHERE r.relation=ANY(%s) ORDER BY d.dataset_id,r.relation
